options.title: Why Couldn't This Mississippi Tanker Stop?
options.first_line: A tanker {fact5} feet long lost its steering on the Mississippi at New Orleans. Why couldn't it stop?
options.first_frame: 3D, late light over the Mississippi at New Orleans: the long tanker swinging off its line toward the camera, its rudder glowing amber under the stern, the caption 'NOV 2026 · MISSISSIPPI RIVER, NEW ORLEANS', a length tag on the hull and the reconstruction tag.

options.title: The Mississippi Tanker Whose Rudder Jammed
options.first_line: On the Mississippi at New Orleans, a tanker's rudder jammed. What happens to a ship that can't steer?
options.first_frame: 3D close under the tanker's stern in the brown river water: the rudder blade hard over, already amber, the propeller turning, the place caption and the reconstruction tag.

options.title: New Orleans: Why Did a Tanker Hit a Docked Riverboat?
options.first_line: A docked riverboat at New Orleans. A tanker coming at it, and nobody on the tanker can turn it. Why?
options.first_frame: 3D from the riverboat's dock: the white riverboat moored in the foreground, the dark tanker's bow growing bigger across the river, the place caption and the reconstruction tag.

why: It names the tanker and the river, asks a question you can picture a giant ship failing to answer, and keeps both the cause and the outcome back, while B's title gives away the jammed rudder and C's title gives away the crash.
